# JeMa Jobs help

<!-- Generated by tools/build_help.php from source.json; edit the source, not this file. -->

Version 2.0.3 | 2026-09-03

## Overview

Your profile, jobs, applications and appointments form the working process.

1. Complete your profile and required documents first.
2. Save a job and prepare an application from it.
3. Manage the application and its appointments in their respective sections.

A job status is separate from an application status. Saving a draft does not send it.

[Create and edit jobs](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=jobs&lang=en-GB) | [Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB) | [Calendar and follow-ups](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=calendar&lang=en-GB)

## Profile and preferences

Personal details and preferences support your application work.

1. Set contact details, region, time zone, app language and profile links.
2. Enter desired roles, locations, working arrangement, job types and minimum/maximum workload.
3. Add salary, availability, benefits, exclusions and language skills; save your changes.

Changing the app language does not translate your own text or documents. Bern Stadt, Region Biel and Region Solothurn are Swiss regions.

[Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB) | [Profile links](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile_links&lang=en-GB) | [Documents and versions](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=documents&lang=en-GB)

## Sign-in and security

A password and optional authenticator protect your account.

1. Register or sign in with your email address.
2. Set up two-factor authentication in your profile and confirm the authenticator code.
3. Use password recovery if needed; check automatic device time when a code is rejected.

Do not share passwords, recovery links or authenticator codes with support staff.

[Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB)

## Documents and versions

Master documents and application-specific files can be assigned separately.

1. Upload a file and specify its title, type and actual document language.
2. Edit metadata or replace the file with a new version.
3. Assign required files to an application and inspect them before downloading or sending.

Document language is independent of app language. Assigning a file does not send it.

[Documents and versions](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=documents&lang=en-GB) | [Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB)

## Search for jobs

Quick import handles one or more known advertisements. Profile-based search keeps your changes until you load the defaults again.

1. Paste one or more verified advertisement URLs into quick import, one per line.
2. Profile defaults deliberately replace all saved criteria with the current profile values.
3. Adjust the profile-based criteria and start the job search.
4. Take over a job from the result table only after reviewing it.

AI provides suggestions. It creates neither an application nor a job without your Take over action.

[Search for jobs](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=job_platform_search&lang=en-GB) | [Create and edit jobs](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=jobs&lang=en-GB#quick-import)

## Create and edit jobs

A job describes the offer; an application records your application process.

1. Enter a job manually or review proposals from advertisement URLs or pasted text.
2. Check company, full title, location, minimum/maximum workload, working arrangement, contract, salary and source.
3. Save the job; optionally upload the advertisement as PDF or image and prepare an application.

Check duplicates before saving. Verify imported information; the match score is only a guide.

[Create and edit jobs](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=jobs&lang=en-GB) | [Companies and recruiters](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=companies&lang=en-GB)

## Companies and recruiters

Companies group addresses, contacts, jobs and applications.

1. Enter the name, address, region, website and contact details.
2. Mark a company as a recruiter only when it actually serves that role.
3. Open related jobs, applications or contacts through their links.

A company relationship is not an application. Street, postcode/town and telephone appear separately.

[Companies and recruiters](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=companies&lang=en-GB) | [Contacts and contact log](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=contacts&lang=en-GB)

## Contacts and contact log

A contact belongs to a company and may be linked to a job or application.

1. Create or edit the person’s name, role, telephone, email and language.
2. Record conversations and messages with channel, direction, time, status and notes.
3. Attach a file if needed; schedule follow-ups and interviews separately in the calendar.

The contact-log count measures activities, not applications. Open/planned entries are a subset of that count.

[Contacts and contact log](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=contacts&lang=en-GB) | [Companies and recruiters](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=companies&lang=en-GB)

## Application workflow

Draft → Ready → Sent → Interviews → Accepted or rejected.

1. Prepare the application and check its recipient, content and assigned documents.
2. Record actual sending or external submission; status history receives timestamps.
3. Record each interview as a separate appointment and document acceptance or rejection.

Workflow date is the latest included workflow date, not necessarily the next appointment. Draft and Ready do not prove submission.

[Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB) | [Calendar and follow-ups](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=calendar&lang=en-GB)

## Online applications

Actual submission takes place in the external application portal.

1. Open the saved application URL and prepare checked documents.
2. Use downloads, a ZIP package or the temporary folder for external upload.
3. Then confirm the completed submission in JeMa Jobs and add a reference and notes.

Downloading files or opening a portal does not prove submission. The displayed next task does not create an extra calendar event.

[Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB)

## Email and cover letters

Sending email and recording a received reply are different actions.

1. Check SMTP, sender and signature in your profile; test with a deliberately chosen test message.
2. Before sending an application, verify recipient, subject, text and every attachment.
3. Use the cover-letter prompt with the recipient block: company, contact, street and number, postcode and town.

Recording an email or reply logs a message without sending it. Recording does not automatically schedule a follow-up.

[Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB) | [Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB) | [Contacts and contact log](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=contacts&lang=en-GB)

## Calendar and follow-ups

Follow-ups and interviews are explicitly dated appointments.

1. Choose agenda, day, workweek, week or month; Today returns to the current date.
2. Enter each follow-up or interview with date and time, optionally linked to an application.
3. Edit, reschedule or complete the existing appointment; use ICS to export.

Today is green in month and weekly views. Draft, Ready, sending tasks and waiting for a reply do not create appointments; submission and outcomes appear as short evidence entries.

[Calendar and follow-ups](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=calendar&lang=en-GB)

## Connect a calendar

An ICS subscription and Google synchronisation are different connections.

1. Set up calendar access in your profile and keep the private feed address confidential.
2. For Google, connect your account and select the target calendar.
3. Check the latest sync result; contact an admin if workflow migration is still pending.

A downloaded ICS file does not update itself. External events must not be deleted as JeMa-generated duplicates.

[Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB) | [Calendar and follow-ups](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=calendar&lang=en-GB)

## Job-Room

Job-Room registration is separate from application status.

1. Use the Job-Room helper to transfer required application details to the external portal.
2. Tick the registration confirmation only after completing the entry.
3. Interview and the outcome open, hired or rejected then become visible.

The checkbox confirms your entry; it does not transmit anything automatically to Job-Room. An interview is not employment.

[Job-Room](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=job_room_helper&lang=en-GB) | [Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB)

## Lists, filters and reports

Lists and saved reports provide different views of your data.

1. Select field filters and sorting in column headers; reset them when needed.
2. Choose the report’s data source, columns, filters and ordering, then save it.
3. Inspect the preview and export to PDF if needed.

One table row represents one record; long text wraps. Application lists show the workflow date without time.

[Lists, filters and reports](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=reports&lang=en-GB)

## Application dossier

The dossier brings together the selected application and related information.

1. Open the dossier from the specific application.
2. Check the job, company, contacts, documents, history and linked activities.
3. Use the web view or PDF export for your records.

A company contact may handle several applications. Activities must belong to the selected case.

[Application workflow](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=applications&lang=en-GB)

## Sharing

Shares provide limited access to deliberately selected content.

1. Select the record and check recipient, expiry and permissions.
2. Create access and send the link only to the intended recipient.
3. Review existing shares and revoke access no longer needed.

Guests see only shared content. Treat share links as confidential credentials.

[Sharing](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=sharing&lang=en-GB)

## Privacy and cleanup

Application data is private; exports and deletion require care.

1. Inspect the contents of an export before sharing it.
2. Use the affected-record preview before cleanup.
3. Check the status and scope of your cleanup request; the preview alone does not delete data.

Deletion can affect related data. A backup does not replace reviewing your selection.

[Privacy and cleanup](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=privacy&lang=en-GB) | [Sharing](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=sharing&lang=en-GB)

## Users and support

Admins manage users; support access requires the affected user’s active consent.

1. Create a user or open management for an existing account.
2. Check user details, account status and admin role before saving.
3. Enter a user account only with valid support consent, then end the support session.

An admin role alone does not grant support consent. Your own account and sensitive changes have additional protection.

[Users and support](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=admin_users&lang=en-GB) | [Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB)

## Manage job platforms

Admins maintain the platforms offered in research packages.

1. Enter the platform name, base URL and any search template.
2. Check order, activation and available details.
3. Test the links before offering the platform for searches.

A platform is a research source, not an automatic import request or a guarantee of current jobs.

[Manage job platforms](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=admin_job_platforms&lang=en-GB) | [Search for jobs](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=job_platform_search&lang=en-GB)

## Translate content

Record translations are separate from the interface language.

1. Choose your source record and target language.
2. Review the translation prompt before sharing content with an external tool.
3. Check the returned translation before saving or using it.

Changing app language does not translate job descriptions, messages or document files.

[Translate content](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=translations&lang=en-GB) | [Profile and preferences](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=profile&lang=en-GB)

## Action history

The audit records selected actions for traceability.

1. Open the history and inspect time, action and affected area.
2. Use available filters to locate a specific change.
3. Compare the entry with the affected record when investigating.

Audit history is not a full backup or an automatic undo command.

[Action history](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=audit&lang=en-GB)

## Review existing workflow data

The one-time cleanup of generated legacy entries is separate from code deployment.

1. As an admin, review the records, statuses and proposed actions.
2. Preserve unknown cases and confirm only the reviewed plan.
3. Reload the preview if data changes meanwhile; affected records are backed up before modification.

Cleanup cancels obsolete generated entries rather than permanently deleting them. Restoring the entire database is not an appropriate rollback.

[Review existing workflow data](https://jobs.jema.business/?page=workflow_review&lang=en-GB)

JeMa Jobs is proprietary software for explicitly authorised users.

1. Search for a topic or choose a category in central help.
2. Open a page’s lightbulb for the corresponding procedure.
3. Check the displayed version in About and observe the licence rights and restrictions.
